note: One-shot owner step for the named volume elasticsearch_data (PR #34 review r1 R1-01): the native image runs as uid 1000, but a fresh bind directory under runtime/volumes/ belongs to the host user (Linux/WSL hosts whose uid is not 1000) and a data tree left by PR #33 belongs to uid 101; `chown -R 1000:1000 /data` hands both to the service without touching the data. Runs the same grdm-dev/elasticsearch2 image as an explicit root (template run_as 0:0, recorded exception: controls user + cap_add CHOWN only), exits, and elasticsearch waits with service_completed_successfully. Idempotent; no chmod (CAP_FOWNER would be needed). On Docker Desktop the chown is a no-op and harmless.
